Game Overview

In Halloween Idle Fly, the core idea is straightforward: leap into spooky skies as a playful pumpkin, dodging spinning obstacles while chasing shiny coins. Test your agility and wits in this endlessly addictive adventure. A perfect mix of skill and fun, challenge friends to outscore you in this thrilling, high-flying Halloween escapade.
